graph.empty: This run has no jobs yet
graph.paused: Paused by GitHub’s rate limit; this run loads when it lifts

job.pick: Click a job to see its steps and log.
job.noDetails: No details from the host yet

log.label: Log of {{job}}

log.expired: GitHub no longer keeps this log

setup.title: Set up CI
setup.description: Vibe Teamlead creates a private GitHub repository if the project has none and pushes the main branch. GitHub Actions then checks every change in CI.

needed.title: Needed from you
needed.github-app-install: Give the Vibe Teamlead GitHub App access to this repository on GitHub, then try again.
needed.non-github-remote: The project’s origin is not on GitHub. CI works with GitHub repositories only.
needed.public-repo-warning: {{repo}} is public: anyone can read its code.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: Secret values the CI workflow reads, saved as GitHub Actions secrets. Only names are shown: values can’t be read back.

secretDialog.title: Add a CI secret
secretDialog.description: Saved as a GitHub Actions secret of the project’s repository. The value goes to GitHub encrypted and can’t be read back.
secretDialog.name: Name
secretDialog.nameRule: Capital letters, digits and underscores; it can’t start with a digit or GITHUB_.
secretDialog.valueHint: Entered once: it isn’t shown again or kept in the app.

errors.conflict: GitHub’s main has commits this Mac doesn’t have. Pull them into the project; the next merge then pushes.
errors.permissions: The Vibe Teamlead GitHub App isn’t allowed to push to this repository. Give it access on GitHub.
errors.no-connection: GitHub didn’t accept the sign-in. Sign in to GitHub again in Settings.
errors.unavailable: GitHub couldn’t be reached. The next merge tries again.

errors.request: The app couldn’t answer. Try again.
errors.no-connection: Not connected: sign in to GitHub in Settings.
errors.permissions: The Vibe Teamlead GitHub App doesn’t have the permission this needs. Give it access on GitHub.
errors.not-found: Something the app needs is gone on GitHub, or the app has no access to it.
errors.rate-limit: GitHub’s rate limit is reached. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.conflict: That name is already taken on GitHub.
errors.invalid: The project isn’t ready: it must be a git repository with a commit on its main branch, and the input must be valid.
errors.not-set-up: Set up CI for this project first.
errors.timeout: It took too long. Try again.
errors.saved-failed: It was done, but the app couldn’t save that. Try again to record it.

checklist.title: Before CI works
checklist.app: Install the Vibe Teamlead GitHub App
checklist.setUp: Set up CI for this project

readiness.error: The check failed. Try again. The list below is from the last successful check.

readiness.secretSaved: {{name}} saved as a GitHub Actions secret.
